The '''Duel on Kestavel''' was an event that took place in the [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] several months after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Dass Jennir]] and [[Kai Hudorra]] defeated the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Beyghor Sahdett]].
